g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
SS 316L (ASTM A240 / A276), 3 [.118] sheet; knuckles 316 bar
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
GASKET P1-339 20 x 6 on the flange, under the cover land

svg.text: P1-301-301 COVER FLAT PATTERN 3 [.118] 316L 1:5 (K 0.4, inside R3, BA 6.60)
bend skirt DOWN 90° all 4 sides on the brake; weld the 4 corners closed (fillet 3 inside, grind outside)
2012.0 [79.213] x 25 [.98] (shown half length); 4 bends 90° at 603 / 403 [23.74 / 15.87] centres, close with one butt weld at a corner
knuckles: Ø20 316 bar x 38, bore Ø10.2 [.402] ream Ø10 H9 not needed;
pin H10 Ø10 h9 x 130 with R-clip; trough knuckle (109) on a
6 x 38 x 45 leaf welded to the flange back edge (W6)
1. Laser the flat pattern (opening and inlet hole included), brake the 4 skirt bends DOWN, weld corners closed, grind and blend.
2. Fold the upstand strip, butt-weld the seam, fit it on the opening edge (strip inside face flush with the opening), fillet 3 [.12] outside continuous and inside ground
3. Weld the 4 in ferrule (P1-301-303, BPE 14WMP short) over the Ø98.3 hole: outside fillet 3, inside fusion ground flush, no ledge.
4. Hang the cover on the trough with the hinge pins, then weld the cover knuckles to the skirt so the cover lands evenly on the gasket (feeler 3 ±0.5 compression).
5. Fit latches P1-338 (3) and keepers, interlock actuator (P1-332): drill on assembly M5 / M4 (H8, H9). Cover must open to 105° and rest on the hinge stop.
6. Flatness: cover land flat within 1.5 [.06] after welding. Passivate.
